'''Infinity Esports Colombia''' is a the Colombian team of [[INFINITY|Infinity Esports]].

==History==
Infinity puts its eyes on the Colombian competitive. For the Costa Rican team, the limit is infinite and it is not enough to shine in the 2018 Worlds and get a place in the 2019 LLA. "Los infinitos" start a new project in Colombia, the country of one of its great stars: [[Cotopaco]].
